per_query.query: How many days do I have to request a 0% intro balance transfer on Apex Platinum?
per_query.gold_response: Apex Platinum cardholders have 60 days from account opening to request a 0% intro balance transfer. The intro rate lasts for 15 billing cycles, and a fee of 3% or $10 applies.

results.title: Apex Platinum - 0% Intro APR Balance Transfer Rules (2024)

evidence.text: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 15 billing cycles from account opening on balance transfers requested within 60 days of account creation. A balance transfer fee of 3% or $10 (whichever is greater) applies to each transfer. Standard balance transfer APR ranges from 18.24% to 28.24% variable based on creditworthiness after the intro period ends. Transfers cannot be made between existing Apex accounts.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Balance Transfer Processing Timelines (2025)

evidence.text: Standard balance transfer requests take 5 to 7 business days to process and pay out to external card issuers. Expedited transfers are not available. Payments to external accounts continue to be the cardholder's responsibility until the transferred amount appears on the Apex credit statement.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Credit Balance Refund Requests (2025)

evidence.text: Negative balance (credit balance) over $1.00 automatically refunded via direct deposit or check within 30 days of request.

results.title: Apex Preferred Travel - Balance Transfer Intro Rates (2024)

evidence.text: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 12 billing cycles on transfers made within 45 days. A balance transfer fee of 4% or $10 applies. Regular APR ranges from 19.99% to 27.99% variable.

results.title: Apex Business Select - Corporate Balance Transfer Guidelines (2024)

evidence.text: Promotional 0% intro APR for 9 billing cycles on transfers submitted within 30 days. Transfer fee is 3% across all transaction sizes. Regular balance transfer APR is 16.99% to 24.99%.

results.title: Apex Everyday Freedom - 0% Intro APR Terms (2024)

evidence.text: Promotional 0% intro APR for 18 billing cycles on balance transfers executed within 60 days of opening. Balance transfer fee is 3% or $5 minimum. Post-introductory APR is 17.49% to 26.49% variable.

results.title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Balance Transfer Delivery Speed (2025)

evidence.text: Balance transfers require 7 to 10 business days for electronic fund arrival to competitive financial institutions. Cardholders must maintain minimum payments on existing accounts until verified.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Merchant Chargeback Dispute Timeline (2024)

evidence.text: Cardholders may dispute a merchant transaction for billing errors, non-delivery of goods, or defective merchandise within 120 calendar days from the transaction date. Documentation including receipts, cancellation confirmation, and merchant communication logs must be submitted.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Statement Generation & Billing Cycles (2024)

evidence.text: Statements generate monthly on 28th calendar day. Payment grace period is 25 days post statement closing date.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Interest Allocation & Payment Prioritization (2024)

evidence.text: If a balance transfer amount is not paid off before the introductory period ends, interest accrues daily on the remaining balance from the expiration date onward. Payments above the minimum monthly payment are automatically allocated to the balance with the highest APR first.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Annual Fee Billing and Refund Waiver Rules (2024)

evidence.text: Apex Platinum card annual fee is $495 billed on the anniversary month of account opening. The annual fee is fully refundable if the account is closed within 30 days of the fee posting date. Fee waivers cannot be authorized by Tier 1 agents unless a retention offer promotion code is active in CRM.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Balance Transfer Limits & Caps (2025)

evidence.text: Total cumulative balance transfer amount cannot exceed 95% of total approved credit line minus transaction fees. Transfers to pay Apex loans or affiliated credit products are strictly prohibited.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Provisional Credit Allocation Rules (2025)

evidence.text: A provisional credit will be credited to the customer account within 10 business days for disputed billing amounts greater than $25. If the investigation resolves in favor of the merchant, the provisional credit will be revoked with a 10-day advance notification to the cardholder.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Payment Credit Posting Rules (2025)

evidence.text: Online payments submitted before 5:00 PM EST post same business day. Credit line replenishes immediately.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Travel Notification & Security Overrides (2025)

evidence.text: Travel notifications are recommended but optional due to real-time chip and tokenization fraud monitoring. Travel plans can be set up to 90 days in advance.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Proactive Credit Limit Reduction Policy (2025)

evidence.text: Apex reserves right to lower credit lines if significant score drops or missed payments on external accounts occur. Written notice issued within 5 days.

results.title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Balance Transfer Cap Guidelines (2025)

evidence.text: Balance transfer authorization limit capped at $15,000 per request or 90% of total revolving limit. Transfers cannot be canceled once status shifts to Processing.

results.title: Apex Platinum - Zero Liability Fraud Protection Policy (2024)

evidence.text: Apex cardholders incur $0 liability for unauthorized transactions reported within 60 days of the statement date. Unauthorized transactions must be reported immediately via online banking or call center. Temporary credits are issued within 2 business days during investigation.

results.title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Transfer Settlement (2025)

evidence.text: Business balance transfers are processed via automated clearing house (ACH) within 3 to 5 business days. Maximum transfer limit per rolling 30-day window is $50,000.

results.title: Apex Preferred Travel - Processing Timelines & Confirmations (2025)

evidence.text: Processing times average 5 business days for major US bank payees and up to 10 business days for credit unions. Email notification is dispatched upon disbursement.
